name: recoil_state_credits_static_init
description: RecoilStateCredits::StaticInit registers the credits state at-exit destructor callback.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent RecoilStateCredits static-lifetime pass.

RecoilStateCredits::RegisterAtExit is functionally verified under target recoil_state_credits_register_at_exit; atexit is a CRT provider boundary.
